name: daily-note
description: Morning and evening routines for an Obsidian vault. /daily-note:start-my-day builds today's daily note with a short Summary, an Alert list and one heading per meeting. /daily-note:end-my-day completes it: task notes for the tasks marked #note, missing meetings, transcript links with a short recap from the Gemini notes, project tags, text-corrector fixes, a short End of day and a Review list of loose ends and stale CLAUDE.md files. meeting-recap does the recap for one meeting on request. task-note gives a Tasks plugin task a note to write in, created from a template through the Obsidian CLI and linked in the task line, which otherwise stays as it is. Steps are small prompt files run in a fixed order. Scripts do every write to a note, with a backup first.
